Question: Which 5 product categories have the heaviest products on average? Use English names.
text:
SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category,
       AVG(p.product_weight_g) AS avg_weight
FROM products p
JOIN product_category_name_translation t
  ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY avg_weight DESC
LIMIT 5;

-- This query lists the five product categories with the highest average product weight, shown in English.
